note: PROPOSED per-card fees read from the fee matrix in each issuer's MITC, by column position rather than by regex over flattened text. Nothing here is a record yet. A blank cell is left null; only an explicit Nil/Free becomes 0. A row that could not be matched to exactly one card is dropped rather than guessed, and every such row is listed in `unmatched` so the miss rate is visible. A row naming several cards states one fee schedule for all of them, so it is split and each card gets the fee, with `row_as_printed` keeping the line as the PDF set it. Fees are financial figures: they stay candidates until a person checks them against the PDF.
